subject: Forward commitment: lock-step incentive & mid-term true-up
body:
From: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@enkora.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-year commitment question + preferred ramp

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and throughput look promising for our summarization pipeline. We are discussing a 3-year forward commitment (total $2.4M ARR equivalent across token units) but want to propose a lock-step ramp: 30% year 1, 40% year 2, 30% year 3.

Two asks from our procurement side:
- A structured discount schedule that reflects the front-loaded risk for Redwood if usage jumps above the ramp (we prefer breakpoints with true-ups rather than clawbacks).
- A mid-term resync / true-up after 12 months to adjust year 2 allocation based on observed consumption.

Can you share guidance on the maximum commercial discount you can extend for a 3y lock-step, and whether you can approve a mid-term true-up (no retroactive clawbacks, only prospective adjustments)? I attached our internal SOW for context.

Regards,
Claire
Procurement Lead, Enkora AI
Attachments: Enkora_SOW_v3.pdf

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@enkora.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year commitment question + preferred ramp

Claire — great to hear the demo was useful. Attaching a working pricing model with two shapes (flat prepay vs. lock-step ramp) and our recommended approval path. High level:

- For a 3-year forward commitment with the ramp you propose, we can offer up to a 28% blended discount vs list if the customer accepts a limited mid-term true-up (one adjustment at 12 months to reallocate unused tokens prospectively).
- If Enkora requires no true-up and wants retroactive refunds for over/under usage, the discount drops to ~18%.
- We propose SLA credit protection for uptime and a 12-month opt-in cadence for quantization profile updates.

Next steps: I’ve marked fields in the attached spreadsheet where you can toggle ramp %, target effective price, and expected annual token draw. If you want, Ben (CC) can flag any approval constraints for discounts >25%.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Attachments: enkora-pricing-model.xlsx

---
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year commitment question + preferred ramp

Marissa — thanks. Quick internal note: approvals >25% blended discount need Sales Leadership sign-off (that's me) plus Finance pre-approval on ARR recognition schedule. For a blended 28% we need to validate: (1) estimated token velocity and conservative churn assumptions, (2) whether customer will accept prospectively applied true-up only (no retro refunds), and (3) whether we can capture a hard minimum monthly commitment for year 1 to protect utilization.

Can you confirm the minimum monthly floor Enkora is willing to accept for Y1? Also, we should offer a structured mid-term resync in writing (12-month window) but keep contractual clawbacks out — instead use a forward credit that applies to year 2. That aligns with our billing policy.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

---
From: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@enkora.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@enkora.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year commitment question + preferred ramp

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the clarity. Enkora is comfortable with a forward credit (applied to year 2) rather than retro refunds. For Y1 floor, procurement can commit to a 25% monthly minimum (i.e., 75% of the pledged Y1 volume spread monthly). We need the true-up to be documented in the SOW and the pricing appendix.

Attachments: Enkora_SOW_v3.pdf (same as prior)

Regards,
Claire

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@enkora.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year commitment question + preferred ramp

Claire — that works. Ben and Finance are comfortable moving forward with the 28% blended discount under these guardrails:
- 25% Y1 monthly floor must be in SOW pricing appendix
- Single 12-month true-up; any surplus in Y1 will become a forward credit applied to Y2 pricing (no retroactive cash refunds)
- Redwood to provide a 90-day notice window for any changes to quantization/feature access that materially affect cost; otherwise changes are subject to service credits per SLA

I’m attaching a redline to the SOW and a DocuSign link for initials on the pricing appendix. If those look good we’ll route for final signature.

Marissa

Attachments: Enkora_SOW_v3_redline.pdf, https://na1.docusign.net/ENK-2027-042-sign

---
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@enkora.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Approval to offer 28% blended on 3y lock-step (with forward credit true-up)

Claire — we’re approved to offer a 28% blended discount for the 3-year lock-step commit under the terms Marissa outlined. I have routed the pricing appendix to DocuSign (link above) and copied Finance & Legal on the signatures. Please initial the DocuSign and we’ll issue the SOW with the pricing appendix included.

Key commercial summary (for your record):
- Total committed value: $2.4M equivalent tokens over 3 years
- Blended discount: 28% vs list (applied across the committed units)
- Year 1 floor: 25% monthly minimum of Y1 pledged units
- True-up: single 12-month true-up; surplus -> forward credit to Y2 (no cash refunds)
- SLA credits and quantization change notice protections included

Ben Carter
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

Procurement note: Claire, if procurement needs a more granular ramp schedule in the DocuSign appendices (monthly percentages across Y1–Y3) we can add a table — just let us know.

Attachments referenced in thread: Enkora_SOW_v3.pdf, enkora-pricing-model.xlsx, Enkora_SOW_v3_redline.pdf
